An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
